kata — keybindings

Global                                 Detail                                     Forms
?         help                         tab/C-j        next tab                    ctrl+o         save or apply
q/ctrl+c  quit                         shift+tab/C-k  prev tab                    esc            cancel
P         projects                     enter          jump to referenced issue    tab/shift+tab  change field
I         Inbox                        esc/backspace  back                        ctrl+e         open editor
D         daemons                      e              edit body                   ctrl+u         clear prompt
F         federation                   c              new comment
C         credentials                  p              set parent                  Filters
L         toggle layout                b              add blocker                 /       search
                                       l              add related                 s       cycle status filter
Graph                                  +              add label                   f       filter (form)
k           up                         -              remove label                c       clear filters
j           down                       a              assign owner                ctrl+r  reset filter form
up/C-p      scroll up                  A              clear owner
down/C-n    scroll down                t              timed assignment
pgup/M-v    page up                    !              set priority
pgdown/C-v  page down
g/C-M-<     first                      Children
G/C-M->     last                       N      new child
enter       open detail                j/k    move child cursor
space       expand/collapse            ↑↓     scroll detail viewport
right       expand                     enter  open child
left        collapse
E           expand/collapse all
n           new issue (form)
v           toggle flat/nested view
o           toggle graph order
x           close
r           reopen
u           undo last issue action

press ? to return
